messages:
maria_eng: Ok spinning up the Galileo cluster (eu-west-gpu3) tomorrow. Need security baseline sign-off before we hand to SRE.
ashok_infra: Copy — what's the minimal checklist you want validated?
kim_security: Short list: IAM roles scoped to SAs, KMS/HSM integration for secrets & disk CMEK, no plaintext secrets in metadata, firewall/egress gating, audit sinks.
lia_devops: Added an initial TF module for SA + iam bindings. Snippet in PR: 
```
resource "google_service_account" "galileo-node-sa" {
  account_id = "galileo-node"
}

resource "google_project_iam_member" "node-kms" {
  project = var.project
  role    = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.galileo-node-sa.email}"
}
```
ashok_infra: Good — don't grant roles/editor. We'll split into node, autoscaler, metrics SAs.
maria_eng: Secrets plan: transit-vault + envelope encryption with KMS. No secrets in instance metadata, never.
kim_security: KMS policy: restrict usage to the exact SA IDs, enable rotation, disable plaintext export, and add audit log sink to sec project. If customer requests HSM-backed keys, follow HSM playbook.
secbot: policy-checker: detected 1 non-compliant IAM binding in current plan (roles/editor on galileo-node-sa).
maria_eng: Ack, pushing fix to the TF now.
lia_devops: Network constraints: private cluster, private control plane, no public node IPs. Egress forced through NAT + proxy, need to block unintended egress to non-approved regions.
nashok_infra: Quota update: asked for 120 A100 GPUs (ticket #INC-4892). FYI cost estimate if fully utilized ~ $45k/mo. Tagging on cost center: infra-galileo.
maria_eng: Add cost controls: enable bin-packing, strict autoscaler profile, preemptible fallback where acceptable.
kim_security: Handover checklist for KMS/HSM: 1) create key ring in target location, 2) create HSM-backed key if required, 3) grant cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to node and app SAs, 4) register key_id in terraform var, 5) add audit sink + alert on key-policy changes.
lia_devops: Also ensure CMEK on boot disks and PVCs: set `disk_encryption_key.kms_key_name = var.kms_key_id`. Will add to node-pool module.
secbot: kms-check: found HSM-compatible key in project: projects/redwood-prod/locations/europe/keyRings/galileo-ring/cryptoKeys/galileo-hsm
maria_eng: Nice. For handoff deliverables: security sign-off, SRE runbook, billing tag confirmation, and the TF plan link. Targeting EOD Friday for final handoff.
kim_security: I can review Thursday morning. Please include rotation schedule (30d) and emergency key-rotation steps.
nashok_infra: Updated PR, re-ran policy-checker, will paste plan link and cost delta when ready.
maria_eng: Ping once the policy-checker is green :thumbsup:
lia_devops: Plan link: https://app.terraform.io/app/redwood/workspaces/galileo/plan/12345
secbot: policy-checker: all clear :white_check_mark:
maria_eng: Great — proceeding with handoff doc and ticket close. Thanks team.
